overview_description.description: Finnt automates manual Accounting & Controllership workflows for enterprise finance teams. Our AI agents work 24/7 with your existing formats (Excel, PDFs, ERPs) to handle journal entries, reconciliations, revenue recognition, fixed assets, and variance analysis. We specialize in exception handling, reducing month-end close time, and freeing teams from repetitive tasks. Fortune 500 companies trust Finnt to streamline finance operations with AI.

product.name: AI Agents for CFO's Teams
product.description: AI-powered automation agents designed to streamline and automate finance procedures for CFOs and their teams, reducing manual tasks and improving accuracy.

product.name: Finance Procedure Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that automates manual finance workflows including data entry, reconciliations, and journal entries, integrating seamlessly with existing financial systems.

product.name: Operators for Finance Automation
product.description: Operators translate human intent into instructions for AI agents, enabling automation of recurring finance tasks and data analysis.

product.name: AI-Powered Budgeting with ChatGPT
product.description: An AI-driven budgeting tool that automates routine budgeting tasks and provides dynamic, real-time financial forecasts and decision support.

product.name: Financial Analytics Platform Integration
product.description: Integration with financial analytics tools that provide data visualization, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling to support financial decision-making.
